settings.permutation: within-instruction relabelling of the one-vs-median-of-rest gaps (reference_free_max_statistic.permute_within_instructions), one stream per subject shared by every statistic
settings.contrast: reference_free_effect: candidate cell rate minus the median of the other candidates

scalars.peak_signed: max over axes of t; UA only, positive = more low grades
scalars.mean_signed: mean over axes of t; UA only, positive = more low grades

settings.mad_detachment: candidate_detachment_measures.detachment: (x_top - median_others) / (1.4826 MAD_others), within-instruction shuffle null

grubbs_normal_theory_null.exact_only_if: the k candidate scalars are i.i.d. normal
grubbs_normal_theory_null.fields: runs/*.json grubbs.p_exact_mc, decisions.grubbs_exact and the outlier_table.csv columns grubbs_*_p_exact, grubbs_exact_* hold this normal-theory p; the names are kept for the files' readers

settings.normal_theory_size_under_shuffle: share of the subject's 10,000 shuffles whose normal-theory p (G, or a candidate's deleted residual) is at or below alpha; Holm of two scalars rejects a shuffle when min(1, 2 min p) <= alpha
settings.holm: Holm over the two scalars of each method; UA pre-registered family is Holm over 3 identities x 2 signed scalars

preregistered_label.ua: hypothesized group (the user-awareness study's safety identities)

settings.ua_general_reference: each safety identity and the affiliation twin against the six general identities: (x_c - mean_gen)/(sd_gen sqrt(1+1/6)) ~ t_5, one-sided toward lower grades and two-sided; shuffle p from the same stream; each general identity against the other five as a placebo (t_4)
settings.ua_paired_grades: identity cell-mean grade minus the six general identities' cell mean, paired over exchanges, two-sided t; Holm over the three safety identities
settings.placebo_targets: every candidate of every null, base and half, and every UA identity outside the safety group, read as a pre-registered target with the scalars of its own family; tables drawn from another table (a sample range or a split half) are marked overlap
settings.k3: defined, no power: the deleted residual has 1 degree of freedom and the normal-theory critical G sits at its ceiling
